scope.nativeLifetime: fresh public API operation scope per call; no benchmark-installed shared scope
scope.lifetimeEvidence: compiler public API contract, not instrumented native construction counts

semantics.cold: fresh child per sample; OS caches NOT cleared
semantics.warm: one persistent cooperating protocol worker; wall includes IPC; no per-operation time(1) high-water attribution
semantics.statistics: median averages the two middle values; p95 nearest rank; sample variance/SD use n-1, null for n<2; variances have squared metric units
semantics.resources: time maxRSS is NOT tree peak; sampled tree RSS is max(sum of live RSS at each poll), not sum of per-process peaks
semantics.isolation: No CPU pinning, cache clearing or isolated cgroup; escaped sessions may evade process-group cleanup
semantics.environment: Inherited environment values are not recorded; LC_ALL=C is applied. Exact command argv is recorded: do not pass secrets as command arguments

limitations: Artifact authenticity, CI run/source identity and actual workload acceptance require separate verification.
Cold means fresh process; OS caches were not cleared.
Warm official CPU/maxRSS is unavailable per operation; sampled process-tree counters are estimates.
Sample variance uses n-1; p95 uses nearest rank and equals max at n10.
Do not average block p95 values; reported full-cell statistics pool raw observations.
Only the corrected candidate Node/Rust cells support equal-coverage engine comparisons.

steps.name: Set up job
Run actions/checkout@v6
Run actions/setup-node@v6
Run pnpm/setup@v2.1.0
Run ./.github/actions/configure-npm-auth
Install locked verifier tools without saving a dependency cache
Pin reviewed library producer and candidate artifact
Run actions/download-artifact@v8
Recheck producer after artifact download
Verify and prepare exact candidate package inputs
Install candidate without Rust compilation
Capture actual runner and candidate resources
Authorize all five catalogs and export authority
Verify unchanged reuse skips audit and regeneration
Isolate producer state and restore checked-in generation surfaces
Verify authority import for downstream consumption
Run candidate source quality and runtime contracts
Capture memory counters after source quality
Run every application test suite with candidate packages
Load reviewed public build inputs
Build all four apps in production mode and finalize proofs
Verify locale source and artifact strictness in the actual consumer
Verify all four version-only regeneration regressions
Prepare isolated inputs for repeated CI measurements
Compare preparation and unchanged reuse on identical runner resources
Compare fresh and persistent workspace verification on identical runner resources
Upload acceptance and final artifact evidence
Post Run pnpm/setup@v2.1.0
Post Run actions/setup-node@v6
Post Run actions/checkout@v6
Complete job

limitations: Native warm sampled peak RSS median is higher than Node; report memory separately from time benefit.
Samples share the same exact input tree, packages and runner within this run; another profile runs on another allocation of the same resource configuration.
Warm API uses a persistent Node process; operation-scoped native state and verification barriers are renewed each call.
No dependency startup or app builds are included in each workspace verify observation.
